query: Lee Jae-myung approval rating Gallup Korea Realmeter late June early July 2026, is approval still falling, what is driving the decline, any dead cross

sources.title: Lee's approval rating rebounds to 54% after dipping to lowest level - Gallup poll
sources.snippet: Gallup Korea survey June 24-26 on 1,005 people: 54% approved, up 3pp from a week earlier; disapproval 36% down 5pp.

sources.title: Lee's approval rating sinks to lowest point since taking office: Gallup poll
sources.snippet: Gallup: approval 51%, lowest since taking office; disapproval 41% (first time above 40%); reasons cited include economy, housing, NEC irregularities. No dead cross.

sources.title: Lee's Approval Hits First 'Dead Cross' Since Inauguration
sources.snippet: President Lee's job approval recorded its first 'dead cross' since inauguration, with disapproval exceeding approval.

sources.title: President Lee Jae Myung's disapproval exceeds approval for first time
sources.snippet: Realmeter: 46.7% approved (down 4.8pp), 49.7% disapproved (up 5.5pp), 3.6% unsure; dissatisfaction over election management and DP infighting.

sources.title: South Korean president's approval falls for sixth week
sources.snippet: Realmeter surveyed 2,502 adults June 22-26: approval fell for a sixth consecutive week to 46.5%; disapproval 49.5%.

sources.title: Lee's approval rating inches up after 6-week decline: poll
sources.snippet: Realmeter: approval rose 0.5pp to 47%, first rise in seven weeks; disapproval fell 0.3pp to 49.2%; rebound tied to 'three megaprojects' (4.755tn won for semiconductors, AI, data centers), held back by falling stocks and weak won.

sources.title: President Lee's Approval Rating Slides for the Sixth Straight Week Due to Election Controversy
sources.snippet: Realmeter weekly trajectory May W2 60.5% to June W4 46.5%; drivers: NEC ballot mishandling and economic pressures (weak won, inflation, housing).

sources.title: President Lee's job approval rating 46.5%... in the 40% range for two consecutive weeks
sources.snippet: Realmeter for Energy Economy News surveyed 2,502 adults June 22-26; approval 46.5%.

sources.title: Lee's approval rating drops for fourth straight week while PPP's reaches highest level in almost a year: Poll
sources.snippet: Following June 3 local elections, Lee's approval fell for fourth consecutive week to 51.5%; PPP reached 44.3%, overtaking the Democratic Party.

sources.title: Lee's approval rating dips to 64 pct over 'excessive' welfare, spending concerns
sources.snippet: Gallup May 1: approval 64% (down 3pp); 'excessive' welfare policies cited as a factor.
